title: JoinResponse
description: HTTP POST /api/join response. wsUrl and wadUrl are absolute so thin clients (web, Android, native) share one sim base.

wsUrl.description: Absolute WebSocket URL (ws:// or wss://). Append ?sessionId= to resume.

wadUrl.description: Absolute HTTP URL for the shareware IWAD (doom1.wad).

role.description: Deprecated hint; actual role arrives in welcome over the WebSocket.
